definitions.recall@k: Retrieved relevant documents / all documents in qrels; not required-evidence coverage.
definitions.precision@k: Retrieved relevant documents / k, including when fewer than k results are returned.
definitions.hit@k: 1 when at least one relevant document occurs in the first k results, otherwise 0.
definitions.mrr@k: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant result within k, otherwise 0.
definitions.ndcg@k: DCG / ideal DCG at k, using gain 2**grade - 1 and discount log2(rank + 1).
definitions.all_evidence@k: 1 when every required evidence group has at least one result within k, otherwise 0.
definitions.evidence_coverage@k: Required evidence groups with at least one result within k / all required groups.
definitions.required_evidence_groups: Alternatives within a group are interchangeable. Absent groups default to one singleton per relevant document.
definitions.empty_return_rate: Explicitly supplied empty rankings / all unanswerable queries. Missing rankings are failures, not successful abstentions.
definitions.macro_averaging: Equal weight per answerable query, including zero scores for missing rankings; no unanswerable queries in retrieval metrics.
